requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Concern-mixing detected: requirement combines functional action (inform security service) with quality criterion (within 2 seconds). Ambiguities regarding trigger event semantics and timing scope are resolved using controlled context (glossary, business rules, constraints). Decomposed into one functional requirement and one quality requirement per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Functional core extracted. Trigger condition resolved to 'event of pane breaking' per AMB-01 supported interpretation.

fields.condition: after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged.
structuring_notes: Quality core extracted. Timing scope resolved to 'after damage detection' per AMB-02 supported interpretation and constraint QLT-01.
